data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a significant gross reserve strengthening of $179.777 million in 2018, representing 36.8% of its opening gross claims outstanding. This strengthening is primarily attributed to adverse development on prior years, particularly the 2017 year of account which is expected to result in a loss, driven by a high frequency of natural catastrophe events. While some older years (2015 and prior, and to a lesser extent 2016) showed positive reserve movements (releases), the overall prior year development was adverse.
raw_causal_phrases: disappointed with the loss on the 2017 year of account
high frequency of catastrophe losses in the second half of the year
The losses hit the reinsurance and property classes most heavily
market was significantly impacted by losses from natural catastrophes.

data.data_quality_notes: There is a contradiction in the report regarding prior year development. Page 4 states 'positive reserve movements... amounting to $24.3m' (a release), while the 'Change in prior year provisions' in the Technical Provisions note on page 18 shows a gross strengthening of $179.777m, which balances the overall claims outstanding reconciliation. The figure from the Technical Provisions note (page 18) has been used as it is part of a balancing reconciliation, indicating it is the definitive gross movement. The $24.3m figure on page 4 is likely a net figure or refers to a specific subset of movements.
